label: GLM 5.3 Flash
headline: Linn Mercy Erupts as Wardens Take Three Posts
war_summary: Linn Mercy has become the war's fiercest sector. Its day's ledger now runs past 7,000 Colonial and 13,100 Warden casualties, and flag actions were still being logged minutes before this edition — Wardens taking three posts in the day's fighting to stand at two against nine, with Outwich Ranch the busiest ground. Palantine Berm boils alongside: twenty-seven actions, ten in the final two hours, the latest at the filing hour, its posts split four Colonial, two Warden, one in ruin, the Pippeli Stones the epicenter. On the Nevish Line the Wardens pressed the Colonials back to a single post, seven against one, at a cost of some 6,700 and 6,300. The Weathered Expanse raised no flag in nearly four hours, yet its day's toll still counts near 9,900 Colonial and 11,800 Warden; seven Warden posts stand, two in ruin. Mooring County remains wholly Warden and silent for five hours. Stlican Shelf, nine posts Colonial, hears the guns warm again, and Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua logged a twentieth exchange. Day 583; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
